annotations.title: Classical text basis for a chart

description: Lists the classical jyotish rules (from Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Phaladeepika, Saravali, Jataka Parijata, Brihat Jataka and others, with chapter and verse) whose conditions VedicDost's rule engine found true in this birth chart, for one life area. Use when the user asks "which shastra says this", "classical basis", or wants verified references.

language.description: User language: hi, en, mr, gu, bn, ta, te or kn (default en). Text and links come in this language.

place.description: Birth place: an Indian city ("Satna") or "City, Country" anywhere ("London, United Kingdom")

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, 24-hour local clock time (optional; without it Lagna and houses are skipped)

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata); found from the place if left out
